jobs.title: Growth Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT MECKA AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The Role

Mecka's datasets come from a global network of contributors capturing real-world data, and that network needs to grow by an order of magnitude while acquisition still runs market by market. In this role, you'll build one acquisition engine with shared channels, playbooks, and measurement that every market runs, and you'll run it hands-on, using AI to do what used to take a team. You'll report to company leadership and work alongside our country teams across APAC, South America, and North America.

What You'll Be Doing:

 - Own contributor acquisition end-to-end, from first touch to first approved capture, and deliver on quality, speed, and volume across programs and markets.

 - Build and scale a channel portfolio across referral, community, field, organic, partnerships, and paid, knowing the cost and conversion of every channel and cutting what doesn't work market by market.

 - Launch referral and affiliate programs with quality controls built in, and a repeatable partner motion with organizations that already reach contributors.

 - Set how Mecka shows up to contributors, from messaging and creative to community presence, so growth builds on itself instead of restarting with every program.

 - Build AI-powered workflows for localized creative, content, and outreach so a small team can cover many markets and languages, shipping experiments on a weekly cadence.

 - Build retention programs that keep contributors engaged.

 - Hire key people and set the playbooks, budgets, and standards in-market teams run, working with Operations to forecast needs by program and market.

What You Bring:

 - 6+ years in growth, including owning supply-side acquisition at a two-sided marketplace, gig platform, or data collection business.

 - Personally built a multi-channel acquisition engine, scaled it in more than one country, and owned its budget, defending cost of acquisition and activation metrics to leadership.

 - Runs growth work through AI tools and automations today, with repeatable systems rather than one-off experiments, and a clear view of what shouldn't be automated.

 - Hired key people and led through a matrix with in-market teams you didn't directly manage.

 - Based in New York or San Francisco, or willing to relocate, and willing to travel regularly to our markets.

Even Better If You Have:

 - Grew a contributor, annotator, or workforce base at a data collection or AI training data company.

 - Scaled supply growth across emerging markets, especially APAC, and made a playbook built in one country work in others.


A NOTE ON APPLYING

Studies show women and candidates from underrepresented groups often only apply when they meet 100% of the listed qualifications, while others apply after meeting 60%. If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

The Role

Our global data capture supply originates directly from specialized sales, business development, and field partner management teams across active regional markets who identify, recruit, onboard, and retain high-value commercial enterprise partners, merchants, and field venue site partners. As the Sales Operations and Analytics Lead, you will architect, build, and scale the operational engine powering these front-line commercial teams worldwide.

Your scope will cover the complete revenue and acquisition stack: designing and deploying comprehensive performance analytics dashboards, establishing target allocation models and variable commission/incentive structures, leading bottom-up market sizing and target account list generation, optimizing cross-market resource allocation, maintaining CRM health and data hygiene, and publishing the definitive weekly executive business review consumed by senior executive leadership.

What You Will Be Doing

 - Reporting: Architect and maintain end-to-end sales analytics infrastructure, automating weekly performance dashboards for every global market, territory, and individual manager to track funnel efficiency, velocity, and conversion.

 - Targets and incentives: Design, model, and administer regional quota systems, target allocation methodologies, and variable incentive compensation plans, partnering closely with finance and HR to calculate accurate monthly and quarterly commission payouts.

 - Account planning: Perform structured Total Addressable Market sizing, segment prioritization, and lead scoring models by country and tier, delivering pre-vetted target account lists to field acquisition teams.

 - System of record: Serve as the primary system administrator and owner for the merchant and partner CRM, enforcing strict pipeline stage definitions, data enrichment standards, and workflow automation rules.

 - Business review: Manage operational resource allocation across active expansion markets and author the core executive Weekly Business Review packet detailing performance trends, operational bottlenecks, and strategic recommendations.

What You Bring:

 - Experience: 5 to 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, strategy & planning, management consulting, or commercial analytics within high-growth marketplace, SaaS, or field sales organizations.

 - Technical skills: Advanced SQL skills for data extraction and transformation, expert financial/data modeling in spreadsheets, and hands-on experience constructing executive-facing dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, PowerBI).

 - Incentive design: Proven experience modeling, implementing, and managing variable compensation, commission, and quota systems, with a thorough understanding of behavioral incentives and financial risk management.

 - Industry: Background in supply-side acquisition, merchant growth, or partner management at a major multi-sided marketplace, hyper-local logistics provider, or delivery tech platform.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a seasoned, high-speed Commercial Leader to build and scale our US commercial robotics division from zero to one. You will own our entire Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy, commercial vision, pipeline velocity, and revenue execution.

Rather than relying purely on technical sales, you will lead with operational value propositions—selling business outcomes, labor savings, and facility performance to corporate executives, commercial real estate owners, and facility management leaders. 

You are an expert at structuring complex deals (both CapEx and recurring subscription/RaaS models) and accelerating deployments across key verticals like healthcare, hospitality, aviation, and commercial real estate.

 - Commercial Strategy & Market Vision: Formulate and execute the US market expansion strategy, identifying high-yield target verticals, pricing models, and deployment roadmaps.

 - Channel & Strategic Partnerships: Build relationships with key industry stakeholders—including national facility management vendors, janitorial distributors, and real estate service providers—to scale distribution rapidly.

 - Deployment Acceleration: Partner closely with internal deployment and operations leads to ensure signed accounts transition smoothly into rapid, multi-site deployments.




WHAT YOU BRING:

 - 6–10+ years of progressive commercial sales leadership, GTM strategy, or business development experience closing complex B2B solutions (e.g., enterprise hardware/IoT, commercial real estate tech, facility services, or industrial equipment).

 - Mastery of executive-level value selling—ability to pitch CFOs, VPs of Operations, and procurement teams on financial ROI, payback periods, and operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Global Payroll & Benefits Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT MECKA AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.


THE ROLE

We’re looking for a hands-on Global Payroll & Benefits Manager to own payroll and benefits across Canada and the United States while helping us build the infrastructure to support a growing global team.

This is an end-to-end ownership role. You will ensure our people are paid accurately and on time, administer competitive benefits programs, manage payroll and benefits providers, and build reliable processes that can scale as we add employees, entities and countries.

You’ll work closely with People, Finance, Legal and external partners—including payroll providers, benefits brokers, PEOs and employers of record. The right person is highly detail-oriented, responsive to employees and comfortable moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term process improvement.




WHAT YOU’LL DO


PAYROLL

 - Own end-to-end payroll for employees in Canada and the United States, including multi-provincial and multi-state payroll.

 - Coordinate international payroll and contractor payments through employers of record, local providers and global platforms.

 - Review and process new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, commissions, leaves, taxable benefits, deductions and other payroll inputs.

 - Ensure accurate and timely tax remittances, statutory filings and year-end reporting, including T4s, Records of Employment, W-2s and other required documentation.

 - Manage payroll reconciliations, funding, approvals and post-payroll reporting.

 - Partner with Finance on journal entries, payroll accruals, general-ledger reconciliation, budgeting and audits.

 - Maintain clear controls, documentation and approval processes so payroll remains accurate, secure and audit-ready.

 - Monitor changes to payroll and employment requirements across the jurisdictions where we operate.


BENEFITS

 - Administer benefits programs across Canada and the United States, including health and dental coverage, retirement programs, life and disability insurance, leave programs and employee perks.

 - Lead enrolments, qualifying-life-event changes, terminations, employee communications and ongoing benefits support.

 - Manage relationships with benefits brokers, carriers, retirement providers and other vendors.

 - Coordinate annual benefits renewals and open enrolment, reviewing utilization, employee needs, cost and market competitiveness.

 - Ensure payroll deductions and employer contributions are accurate and reconciled with benefits-provider records.

 - Support the development of consistent global benefits principles while accounting for local market and statutory requirements.

 - Help evaluate and implement benefits programs as Mecka enters new countries.


SYSTEMS, PROCESS AND EMPLOYEE EXPERIENCE

 - Serve as the internal subject-matter expert and primary employee contact for payroll and benefits questions.

 - Own the accuracy of payroll and benefits data across our HRIS, payroll, finance and benefits systems.

 - Manage integrations and data flows between platforms, identifying and resolving discrepancies before they affect employees.

 - Improve and automate processes to reduce manual work, strengthen controls and support continued growth.

 - Develop employee-facing documentation that makes payroll and benefits easy to understand.

 - Protect highly confidential employee and compensation information with sound judgment and discretion.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - At least five years of hands-on experience owning payroll and benefits operations.

 - Direct experience running payroll in both Canada and the United States.

 - Strong knowledge of Canadian federal and provincial payroll requirements, including income tax, CPP, EI, Records of Employment and T4 reporting.

 - Strong knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local payroll requirements, including payroll taxes, deductions, wage requirements and W-2 reporting.

 - Experience administering Canadian and U.S. benefits and retirement programs.

 - Experience managing payroll and benefits vendors, brokers or external service providers.

 - Strong reconciliation, reporting and data-management skills.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to meet immovable deadlines.

 - A service mindset and the ability to explain complex payroll or benefits issues clearly and empathetically.

 - Comfort operating independently in a fast-moving environment where processes are still being built.


EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE

 - Experience supporting payroll or benefits across additional international markets.

 - Experience working with an employer of record or global payroll provider such as Deel.

 - Experience with Rippling or another modern HRIS and payroll platform.

 - Experience supporting employees across multiple entities and employment models.

 - Familiarity with payroll accounting, audit controls, SOC 2 requirements or finance-system integrations.

 - Payroll or benefits certification, such as PCP, PLP, CPP, CEBS or Global Payroll Management certification.

 - Experience in a high-growth technology


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within your first six months:

 - Canada and U.S. payroll runs accurately, on time and with clear controls.

 - Payroll, benefits and HRIS data are consistently reconciled.

 - Employees receive prompt, clear support when they have payroll or benefits questions.

 - Key processes and responsibilities are documented and audit-ready.

 - Vendor performance, costs and service levels are actively managed.

 - Mecka has a scalable approach for adding employees and entering new countries.
